numbering: Zero-based steps[n]. The unnumbered outline is act 0.

rulings.defect: The journey counts only five pricing response samples and its about text wrongly dismisses all Ideogram examples as isolated schema-property examples.
rulings.evidence: https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/ideogram/v2/api publishes complete Input JSON (the Halloween skeleton prompt, aspect_ratio 1:1, expand_prompt true, style auto) and complete Output JSON (images containing a URL and seed). It also publishes fal.subscribe and queue submit/status/result examples. Architecture Published examples includes vendor page examples and counts unserved examples with their reasons.
rulings.mustBecome: Correct about; vendor the complete Ideogram Input/Output example with its source and replay it against the served synchronous operation using exactly the published input. Append this replay after the existing last step (judged index 5), capture its generated image URL, and append a download of that captured URL as the effect check. Assert the input-decided dimensions/count only where documented; do not pin the published generated URL or seed. Vendor/count the page's queue-specific examples with explicit notReplayed reasons that their queue wire/operations are unmodeled. Ensure replay accounts for every page example of a served operation, not only the OpenAPI response samples.

rulings.defect: The setup-decided list cardinality is not asserted, while account/vendor-supplied price and currency values are pinned to the documentation fixture.
rulings.evidence: getPricing accepts the one specified endpoint_id and returns pricing for requested endpoints. Its description says custom pricing or discounts may be applied based on account status. Architecture Published examples requires setup-caused counts to be asserted and forbids asserting generated/default values merely to pin the twin's guess.
rulings.mustBecome: Assert prices.length equals 1 and retain the requested endpoint_id and applicable derived pagination assertions. Remove unit_price equals 0.025 and currency equals USD as universal request outcomes; check their shape/type and record undecided reasons for the account-specific pricing and vendor/default currency. Keep the documentation sample itself unchanged in the evidence.

doubts: The five existing pricing steps faithfully create the error preconditions: omitted endpoint_id, missing credentials, unknown model, and an explicitly declared World 429 fault. This is an examples collection, so its consecutive refusals are the published cases rather than a customer-story run.
The nthCall scenario scripts a status refusal, not a stored mutation, and the examples describe it as a World fault.
scope: Exactly one exhaustive independent judgment of every beat/step against the current rejection bar, vendor specs, cited pages and cached demand callers; no pack code reviewed.
